boilerplate-bun - LLM QUICK REFERENCE

STACK: Bun 1.4.2+ workspaces (+ root `catalog` for shared versions) | Next.js 16 | React 19
       TypeScript 5.9 | Tailwind v4 | shadcn/ui on Radix + Base UI | Biome (lint/format)
       Bun services: Bun.serve + oRPC + Zod | Bun.sql | Vercel AI SDK (Anthropic)

APPS (dev URL -> prod subdomain):
  apps/www:3000      - Marketing site          www.brand.localhost     -> www.brand.com
  apps/app:3001      - Application shell       app.brand.localhost     -> app.brand.com
  apps/auth:3002     - Auth screens (mockups)  auth.brand.localhost
  apps/account:3003  - Account settings hub    account.brand.localhost
  apps/docs:3004     - Docs shell              docs.brand.localhost
  apps/help:3005     - Help / support shell    help.brand.localhost
  apps/jobs:3006     - Jobs shell              jobs.brand.localhost
  apps/api:3007      - Bun API: /rpc, /openapi, Bun.sql (SQLite default)
  apps/ai:3008       - Bun AI service: POST /chat (useChat stream), /rpc summarize
  apps/blog:3009     - Blog (MDX, sv + en)     blog.brand.localhost
  apps/legal:3010    - Legal pages (sv + en)   legal.brand.localhost
  apps/story:6006    - Storybook for packages/ui (dev only)

PACKAGES:
  @repo/ui                 - Shared components, blocks, charts, fonts, theme, globals.css
  @repo/tokens             - Design tokens
  @repo/api-contract       - oRPC contract for apps/api (clients import ApiClient)
  @repo/ai-contract        - oRPC contract + ChatMessage for apps/ai (clients import AiClient)
  @repo/typescript-config  - Shared tsconfig presets (base, nextjs, react-library, bun)

COMMANDS:
  bun dev                                   Start every app
  bun --filter @repo/X dev                  Start one app
  bunx shadcn@latest add Y -c packages/ui   Add a shared component
  bun run lint / bun run format             Biome
  bun run typecheck                         TypeScript
  bun run test:services                     bun test for apps/api + apps/ai
  bun run ci                                Full CI gate locally
  docker compose up -d --build              All nine apps in containers

CRITICAL RULES:
  1. UI components -> packages/ui (NEVER add shadcn components to an app)
  2. Layers flow one way: tokens -> components -> blocks -> views -> pages
  3. Apps never import other apps; frontends use @repo/api-contract / @repo/ai-contract
  4. Shared deps -> root `catalog`, referenced as "catalog:"; never a literal range for those
  5. API change -> contract first (packages/*-contract), then implement in the service, then test
  6. Style -> Biome only, no semicolons, double quotes, 100-char lines

KEY FILES:
  apps/<app>/src/views/                  - Page-level compositions (pages render a view)
  apps/<app>/src/app/                    - Next.js routes (thin page.tsx wrappers)
  apps/api/src/router.ts                 - API handlers (implements packages/api-contract)
  apps/ai/src/chat.ts, src/tools/        - AI chat endpoint and model-callable tools
  apps/ai/src/router.ts                  - Structured AI endpoints (implements packages/ai-contract)
  packages/ui/src/components/            - Shared UI
  packages/ui/components.json            - shadcn config and registries
  package.json (root)                    - catalog, scripts, gates

DECISION TREE - Where does code go?

  Is it a UI component?
    -> Shared across apps? -> packages/ui/src/components/
    -> Reusable section (hero, footer)? -> packages/ui/src/blocks/
    -> App-specific? -> apps/<app>/src/components/

  Is it a page?
    -> Composition -> apps/<app>/src/views/<route>-view.tsx
    -> Route -> apps/<app>/src/app/<route>/page.tsx (renders the view)

  Is it data / server logic?
    -> Typed endpoint -> packages/api-contract + apps/api/src/router.ts
    -> AI feature -> packages/ai-contract (+ chatTools for tools) + apps/ai/src/

  Is it documentation?
    -> Contributor docs -> CLAUDE.md / CONTRIBUTING.md
    -> Component docs -> apps/story/stories/

NAMING CONVENTIONS:
  Components: PascalCase (UserProfile.tsx) | Blocks & views: kebab-case files, PascalCase exports
  Utilities: camelCase (formatDate.ts) | Pages: lowercase-hyphen (user-settings/page.tsx)

IMPORTS:
  import { Button } from "@repo/ui/components/button"
  import { Hero } from "@repo/ui/blocks/hero"
  import { cn } from "@repo/ui/lib/utils"
  import type { ApiClient } from "@repo/api-contract"
  import type { AiClient, ChatMessage } from "@repo/ai-contract"

READ ORDER FOR FULL CONTEXT:
  1. LLMS.txt (this file)
  2. CLAUDE.md (architecture, dependency rules, quality gates)
     docs/architecture/<topic>.md (full behaviour of each domain it summarises)
  3. apps/api/README.md, apps/ai/README.md (the services)
  4. packages/ui/components.json (component registries)
